༄༅/ /rgyal po gser gyi lag pa'i smon lam dang 'brel ba'i mar me ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul bde legs 'byung gnas bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal po gser gyi lag pa'i smon lam dang 'brel ba'i mar me ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul bde legs 'byung gnas bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ 'dir mar me 'bul tshul khyad par can zhig brjod par bya ste/ mchod pa rnams sta gon byas nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du btang*/ tshe dpag sogs lha gzhan gyi sgo nas kyang rung mod/ spyan ras gzigs bdag bskyed byed na chog gsum bskyed dam/ bsdu na/ ༈ rang nyid skad cig gis spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur par bsam la/ byin brlabs ni/ auṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ auṃ swa bha wa shuddha sarba dharmaḥswa bha wa shuddho3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las auṃ las rin po che'i snod nam mkha' ltar yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du auṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mar me la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad gang zhing khyab par gyur/ auṃ badzra a lo ke āḥhūṃ/ auṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ auṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ lan gsum/ auṃ arghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas/ shapta āḥhūṃ/ bsdu na des mchogargyas par na/ auṃ swa bhā wa bi shuddhe dharmāḥte badzra siddhi hūṃ na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tatkhaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ auṃ a mṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ auṃ kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇaṃ adya nutpanna twad/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te auṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ auṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddha lo tsa ni sarba artha sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs te/ bdag gi bsam pa'i zhes sogs brjod/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang*/

lha klu gzhi bdag 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ dzaḥ rdo rje 'chang chen la sogs pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad dang*/ /gsang bde 'jigs gsum la sogs pa/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pa sogs/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /nye ba'i sras chen rnam brgyad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ /nyan thos chen po mchog brgyad sogs/ /nyan rang 'phags tshogs thams cad dang*/ /ye shes mgon po la sogs pa/ /chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyang*/ /de ring mchod sbyin chen po yi/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /tshangs pa brgya byin dbang phyug sogs/ /steng gi lha tshogs thams cad dang*/ /dga' bo 'jog po la sogs pa/ /'og gi klu chen thams cad dang*/ /sa yi lha mo brtan ma sogs/ /sa bdag gzhi bdag thams cad kyang*/ /de ring mchod sbyin chen po yi/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /dgyes bzhin myur du gshegs nas kyang*/ /rang rang gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /kā ma la ya st+waṃ/ hūṃ/ stong gsum 'jig rten khams 'di na/ /mchis pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dang*/ /dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang*/ /'dod yon lnga dang rgyal srid bdun/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs dang*/ /gling bzhi ri rab lhun po dang*/ /nyi zla sman dang nags tshal ni/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /khyad par stong gsum khyon ltar du/ /yangs pa'i rin chen snod dbus su/ /mar gyi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang*/ /ri rab lta bur rab brtan pa'i/ /sdong bu snum ldan btsugs pa las/ /'jig rten khams kun gsal byed pa'i/ /nyi zla'i 'od ldan mar me mchog /brgya phyag grangs ldan 'di rnams ni/ /rdo rje 'chang chen la sogs pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gus pas 'bul lo bzhes nas kyang*/

/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /gsang bde 'jigs gsum la sogs pa/ /yi dam lha tshogs thams cad la/ /gus pas 'bul lo= /mchog dang thun mong =/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa sogs/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /gus pas= /mchog dang = /nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/ /gus= /mchog= /nyan thos chen po mchog brgyad sogs/ /nyan rang 'phags pa thams cad la/ /gus= /mchog= /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po sogs/ /chos skyong srung ma thams cad la/ / gus= /mchog= /gzhan yang lha klu gzhi bdag sogs/ /mgron du 'os pa thams cad la/ /gus pas 'bul lo bzhes nas kyang*/ /rab brtan tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /gser dngul rin chen dngos grub stsol/ /sna tshogs 'bru yi= /rkang bzhi phyugs kyi= /myur mgyogs rta yi= /zas mchog ro brgya'i= /'jam gnyen gos kyi= /bzhon mar 'o zho'i= /longs spyod snyan grags= /nad med bde skyid= /sna tshogs 'bru bcud= /lo tog rgyas pa'i= /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /khyad par man lan gsum sogs brjod kyang legs so/ /de nas sngon rgyal po gser gyi lag pas mar me phul ba'i lo rgyus mdo nas 'byung ba ltar smon lam gdab cing 'bul ba ni/ /༈ mar me'i snod ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams tsam du gyur cig /snying po ni ri'i rgyal po ri rab tsam du gyur cig 'od kyis ni srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba yan chad dang*/ gzhan yang lcags ri chen po'i phyi rgyab na sems can rang gi las kyi sgrib pas bsgribs pa'i mun nag chen po'i nang na rang gi lag pa brkyang bskum yang mi mthong ba'i gnas tshun chad snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig yun ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas ji srid bzhugs pa de srid du gnas par gyur cigagrangs ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas grangs med pa re re'i spyan lam du gsal bar gyur cig

mar me 'di gzugs med pa'i gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig de ltar gsal ba'i mod la gzugs med pa'i lha rnams mar me'i 'od kyis bskul ma thag tu mtshan dang dpe byed du ldan nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i skye mched bzhi las grol te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gtan la sogs pa snyoms par 'jug pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' bde rtse gcig pa nyams su myong nas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par gyur cig /mar me 'di 'dod khams kyi lha rnams kyi gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /'dod khams kyi lha rnams kyang lha'i 'dod pa'i longs spyod la sems ma chags shing*/ rang gi sems la blta bas bsam gtan bzhi la rim gyis snyoms par 'jug pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di lha ma yin rnams kyi gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /lha ma yin rnams kyi nga rgyal dang khro gtum dang sems kyi gdug pa zhi nas tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan nas zhi gnas kyi sems yid la byed pa dang ldan par gyur cigamar me 'di gling bzhi'i mi rnams kyi gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cigagling bzhi'i mi rnams kyang sdug bsngal brgyad las thar nas brtson 'grus ky-i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di byol song rnams kyi gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /byol song rnams gcig la gcig za ba dang*/ brdeg brdung dang*/ bsad pa dang*/ bkol ba'i sdug bsngal dang blun rmongs las thar nas shes rab rnam pa gsum dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di gshin rje'i 'jig rten du snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /gshin rje rnams gsod gcod byed pa dang brdeg brdung gi las las thar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrags pas sems can thams cad la phan pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur cig

/mar me 'di yi dwags kyi gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /yi dwags rnams kyang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal las thar nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyi thugs rje chen po'i byin gyis/ zas dang skom gyi phongs pa rnams longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang ldan zhing sby-in pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cigamar me 'di dmyal ba'i gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /dmyal ba rnams ni sngon gyi las ngan pa'i rnam par smin pas tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba nyams su myong ba las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thugs rje'i byin gyis brlabs kyis dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal tshad med pa las thar nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di 'dzambu'i gling gi phyi rol mun nag nang na 'thoms pa'i sems can rang gi rkang lag brkyang bskum tsam yang mi mthong ba'i gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /de dag sngon gyi las ngan pa'i rnam par smin pas zas dang skom 'dod pa las/ nam mkha' la ni rang gi lcags kyi sen mo yod pa bsnyabs pas zas dang skom ma rnyed nas rang gi lus zin pa dang sha bcad de za ba de dag de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi thugs rje'i byin gyis mun nag chen por 'thoms pa las thar nas bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skye bar gyur cig /gzhan yang mar me 'di klu'i gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /des klu rnams gti mug dang ser sna'i mdud pa las grol te gtong ba'i blo dang ldan zhing*/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang*/ me dang*/ bye tshan la sogs te 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las thar nas/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro zhing srog 'tsho ba'i zhi gnas kyi chu thig snying la gnas nas 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di lto 'phye chen po'i gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig

/des lto 'phye chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi nas dga' ba rgya mtsho rnam par 'phrul ba'i shugs dang ldan par gyur cig /mar me 'di gling gi spy-ir gnas pa'i sa bdag dang*/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ sa bdag gi rgyal po pe ta li/ sa'i rgyal po chen po dang*/ rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ mtsho phran dang*/ rdzing dang*/ na ba la gnas pa dang*/ klung chen po dang*/ klung phra mo dang*/ chu mig dang*/ lu ma la gnas pa dang*/ gangs ri mthon po'i rgyud la gnas pa dang*/ ri nag po dang g.ya' dang*/ sha srang dang*/ spang ri dang*/ nags chen po dang*/ shing gcig pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grong khyer dang*/ ljongs na gnas pa rnams kyi gnas su snang zhing gsal bar gyur cig /de dag so so'i 'khrul ba'i rtog pa thams cad byang nas dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig /de ltar mar me'i 'di'i yon tan ni bdag gis kyang gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin 'di phul bas/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad kyi zhabs drung du skyes te/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad kyi dpal mgon du gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rgyal po gser gyi lag pas rang gi lag pa g.yas la snum ras dkris te me sbar nas sangs rgyas mar me mdzad 'khor bcas la phul ba'i tshe smon lam du btab pa'o/ /da lta kha cig tshe chog dang sprel yang*/ smon lam 'di ltar byas te phul na phan yon lhag par che bas legs so/ /de nas smon lam gzhan gdab pa ni/ /༈ 'di ltar mar me phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas bdag sogs 'gro ba thams cad ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las thar bar gyur cig skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar gyur cig tsha grangs bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal thams cad las= /dbul zhing phongs pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad las=/ 'thab cing rtsod pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad las=/

'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad dang gnod pa thams cad las=/ gdon gyis bskyed pa'i nad dang gnod pa thams cad las=/ lus tshe srog la bar du gcod pa'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /bsod nams longs spyod la bar du gcod pa'i gnod pa thams cad=/ dbang thang rigs rgyud la bar du gcod pa'i gnod pa thams cad=/ snyan grags 'khor g.yog la bar du gcod pa'i gnod pa thams cad=/ rta phyugs sgo nor la=/ kha zas gos bzang la=/ bzhon mar 'o zho la=/ 'bru bcud lo tog la=/ mdor na 'jig rten khams kyi mi nad phyugs nad 'thab rtsod 'khrugs longs la sogs pa'i bkra mi shis pa'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig de nas g.yang len mdor bsdus byed par 'dod na g.yang rten gyi rdzas ci 'grub bsags nas/ /༈ kyai'am hūṃ/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin brlabs rnams/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du byon/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha yi g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du byon/ /dga' bo la sogs klu yi g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du byon/ /nyi ma la sogs gza' yi g.yang*/ /de ring = /smin drug la sogs rgyu skar g.yang*/ /de ring = /'dzam bha la sogs nor lha'i g.yang*/ /de ring = /'khor los bsgyur sogs mi yi g.yang*/ /de ring = /rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyi g.yang*/ /de ring = /bkra shis rtags brgyad dag gi= /de ring = /yid bzhin nor bu'i dpal gyi= /de ring =/ bum pa bzang po'i gter gyi= /de ring = /dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa'i= /de ring = /rgya mtsho chen po zab pa'i= /de ring = /ri rab lhun po mtho ba'i= /de ring =/ nyi ma zla ba gsal ba'i= /de ring = /nam mkha'i khams ni yangs pa'i= /de ring = /sa gzhi'i khyon ni rgya che'i g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du byon/ /mdor na 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das/ /g.yang rnams thams cad 'dir 'dus shig /sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas par shog

/ dbang thang rigs brgyud dar bar shog /snyan grags 'khor g.yog rgyas par shog /bsam don thams cad 'grub par shog /lha yi bkra shis kun thob shog /klu yi bkra shis kun thob shog /lha min bkra shis kun thob shog /mi yi bkra shis kun thob shog /bkra shis thams cad thob gyur nas/ /rtag tu bde skyid ldan par shog /de nas/ skyabs gnas dam pa khyed rnams ni/ /mchod spyin gnas su spyan drangs nas/ /mchod pa'i skabs 'dir bdag cag gi /ma 'byor ba sogs nyes pa'i tshogs/ /ci mchis thugs kyis bzod bzhes nas/ /rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs/ /zhes brjod cing gshegs gsol bya'o/ /phyi ma'i don gtso bor yin na/ g.yang gi skor bzhag chog go /de ltar rten gyi drung du mar me phul ba'i phan yon ni/ 'phags pa mar me 'bul ba zhes bya ba'i mdo las/ shā ri'i bu/ mar me 'bul ba cung zad cig phul ba las mngon par 'grub pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po de'i rnam par smin pa ni/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma gtogs/ lha dang bcas tshangs pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang*/ dge sbyor dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgus bstan par mi nus so/ /zhes dang*/ shā ri'i bu mar me phul ba des bsod nams kyi phung po ji tsam du dpag tu med grangs med pa yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ba'i don de ni de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen te/ zhes dang*/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la mar me dbul ba phul ba de 'chi dus kyi tshe snang pa bzhi thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ mdun na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba mthong ba dang*/ mdun na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba mthong ba dang*/ lha'i 'khor gnas pa mthong ba nas/ sangs rgyas mthong ba ste/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ mar me phul ba'i rnam smin 'di yin te/ / 'chi dus byed tshe dran pa nyams mi 'gyur/ /de la phyogs rnams snang bar gyur par 'byung*/

/sngon chad ma mthong gzugs bzang rnams kyang mthong*/ /de ni shi 'phos mtho ris nges 'gro shing*/ /lha yi stan la de lus 'dug par shes/ /zhes dang*/ shā ri'i bu mar me phul nas de ltar rnam par smin pa dpag tu med pa yongs su bzung ba yin no/ /zhes dang*/ mar khur ma zad/ til gyi mar me yang de dang 'dra bar mchog yin te/ de nyid las/ til gyi mar me rjes su bzung nas chos kyi mar me rjes su 'dzin to/ /mar me phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des tshogs dpag tu med pa brgyad 'thob ste/ /zhes sogs der phan yon mang du bshad kyang mtshon tsam mo/ /gzhan yang las rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo las/ /mar me phul ba'i phan yon ni bcu ste/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'jig rten na mar me lta bur 'gyur ba dang*/ /sha'i mig rnam par dag pa 'thob pa dang*/ lha'i mig rnam par dag pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i chos rnams shes par 'gyur ba dang ma rig pa dang gti mug gi mun pa sel ba dang*/ shes rab kyi snang ba 'thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ de 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe ni mun pa na gnas par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang*/ mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ myur du mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ de dag go /zhes gsungs so// //zhes pa 'di ni dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i tshe gzungs sogs la mar nang ba 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngo bor shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba ste/ phyis sna lam sngags 'chang rnam rgyal zhes bya bas dad pas par du bsgrubs pa'i tshe par gyi yi ge pa ni tho lo'i sngags 'chang tshe dbang mgon po'o// //madga laṃ/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/rgyal po gser gyi lag pa'i smon lam dang 'brel ba'i mar me ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul bzhugs/ -PAGE 216--PAGE 217--PAGE 207-
